title: Citation Graph for FFT on Microcontrollers
description: Interactive citation graph visualization showing relationships between academic papers on FFT implementations for microcontrollers.
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Signal Processing
FFT
Academic Research
Citation Analysis
learningObjectives: Explain how a citation network encodes papers as nodes and directed citation relationships as edges
Identify foundational FFT papers by their large node size, since node diameter is scaled to citation count
Distinguish the color-coded research domains in the graph, including foundational, manycore, and FPGA approaches to FFT implementation
Analyze how filtering by research area or minimum citation count changes which clusters remain visible
Evaluate the coverage limits of a 15-paper demonstration dataset relative to a systematic search using the Scopus, OpenAlex, or Semantic Scholar APIs
